name: Krev
summary: Team of AI specialists that research, create content, run ads and help operate a Shopify ecommerce brand.
description: Krev is an ecommerce growth suite whose named AI employees share one brand memory: Scout researches competitor ads, Luna creates product photos, UGC-style content and ads, Kai manages Meta and TikTok campaigns, Chloe schedules social posts, Toshi edits the Shopify store, Max works on SEO/AEO, and Rue handles email. You connect Shopify, ads and socials, brief a goal, then approve work before anything goes live. Enterprise is custom. First monthly payment has a conditional 7-day money-back guarantee.
features: Named AI employees for research, creative, ads, social, Shopify, SEO/AEO and email
